help.title: Make your first move.
help.body:
MOVE: Right-click ground to travel. Your route appears on the minimap.
ATTACK: Right-click a hostile to approach and attack. Basic attacks use no mana.
TARGET: Left-click selects. Tab finds a foe; Backspace clears. S stops your hero.

CAST: Use {skills} or the on-screen buttons. W/E/R unlock as you level.
GROW: Spend skill points with {upgrade} or the arrows above the hotbar.
SHOP: Press P at your base. Spend earned gold on items that suit your class.

OBJECTIVE: Follow your minions. Clear every tower in one lane, then destroy the enemy base.
SURVIVE: Let minions take tower fire. If defeated, wait for your respawn.
READ THE FIELD: Your hero has a double ring; allies have squares; enemies have triangles.

CAMERA: Y toggles hero follow; Space returns to your hero. Wheel zooms; Settings > Camera remembers the distance.
Left-click the minimap to scout. Alt + right mouse orbits the 3D view.
Need this guide again? In a match, press {help_key}. Escape opens the game menu.
help.dismiss: Enter the arena   /   Escape or F1
help.phone.body:
YOUR FIRST MATCH

MOVE: Drag the left stick. Release to stop.
ATTACK: Tap the large right button; hold to repeat. No mana needed.
TARGET: Drag ATTACK to extend the reticle. Release on a highlighted foe to lock. Drag to X to cancel.
FARM: The small minion and tower buttons target only that category.
UTILITY: Dash moves in your stick direction; drag it to aim. Haste boosts movement briefly.
SKILLS: Q/W/E/R surround ATTACK. Tap to use the locked target, or drag to aim.
GROW: Abilities unlock as you level. Tap RANK, then a glowing skill to spend a point.
WIN: Follow your minions, clear all towers in one lane, then destroy the enemy base.
RECOVER: Return to your base to heal and shop. If defeated, wait to respawn.
LOOK: Tap the minimap to scout. Move the stick to follow your hero again.

The match continues while menus are open. Stay connected for the next round.
